item.description: Notice comes into force at 9am tomorrow. The warning is expected to come into force at 9am tomorrow, (via JM Madeira)

item.title: Njoya Kader will be a reinforcement for Nacional
item.description: Cameroonian striker Njoya Kader is expected to be announced today as Nacional's reinforcement, probably being the last of this transfer period. item.title: The majority of students enrolled on the 1st day of the special season missed the exam
item.description: Of the 11,693 students registered on the 1st day of this special season, only 4,920 attended. The majority of students registered on the first day of the special period for secondary education exams missed the test, according to data released today by the Ministry of Education. The special season started on Thursday (via JM Madeira)
